definitions.explanation: Physical or mental suffering caused by hard work or difficult circumstances. A somewhat literary or formal word emphasizing the burden of effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{労苦|ろうく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{報|むく}われた。
⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{労苦|ろうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: I grew up without knowing my parents' hardships.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{労苦|ろうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、ようやく⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After overcoming many hardships, I finally made the business a success.

notes:
{労苦|ろうく} combines {労|ろう} (labor) and {苦|く} (suffering), making it more emphatic than ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ — hardship, trouble (common, everyday word)
- {労苦|ろうく} — hardship, toil (more literary, emphasizes the weight of effort)
- {辛苦|しんく} — suffering, affliction (formal, written)

{労苦|ろうく} is often used in contexts where someone has endured sustained effort or difficulty, particularly when acknowledging or honoring that effort.
